transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?
I'm here because I have an incredibly intense, overwhelming fear of heights that I just can't manage anymore. It has become so severe that I really need some help dealing with it.
Do you experience immediate anxiety or panic when exposed to heights, even if there's no real danger?

Yes, absolutely, it happens the exact second I realize I'm high up. Even if I'm completely safe inside a building behind a strong glass window, this sudden, overwhelming wave of panic just hits me instantly. It's like my brain completely takes over with terror.
Do you go out of your way to avoid heights, like avoiding tall buildings, bridges, or stairs, even if it causes problems in your daily life?

Yes, I completely avoid them at all costs. I won't drive over bridges or go into tall buildings, which makes my daily commute much longer and has even forced me to turn down job interviews on high floors. It is incredibly disruptive and severely limits where I can go.
